requirement: R13 wave 1 shell entries with maintained states and verified inventory statuses

proof.name: layout is a persistent primary navigation and carries the active route

states.success: persistent desktop sidebar + mobile primary nav; active route aria-current; 9 future sections marked pending; navigation keeps one shell instance
states.empty: not applicable: layout has no data source/view model
states.loading: not applicable: layout has no async work
states.error: not applicable: layout has no data source; route-level diagnostics has its own states

proof.name: index is a real success landing with working onward navigation

states.success: runtime overview landing, two surface cards, Open diagnostics link, data-state=success, document title Overview | RM3 Foldkit shell
states.empty: not applicable: static landing has no data source and no empty variant
states.error: not applicable: static content cannot fail independently of the shell

proof.name: not-found is a terminal error state with recovery navigation

states.error: role=alert, data-state=error, exact path, Back to overview link, path-specific document title
states.success: not applicable: a not-found route is terminal
states.empty: not applicable: the error is the state
states.loading: not applicable: no async lookup; route parsing is synchronous

proof.name: shell preserves theme, title, focus and scroll facts across navigation

states.success: desktop sidebar + mobile nav, theme toggle, shell title/route label, clicks/theme readout
states.empty: not applicable: shell frame has no data source
states.loading: not applicable: no async shell work
states.error: not applicable: no shell data source; route states own errors

entries.caveat: wired, not verified: the legacy sidebar footer inventory/live-refresh stack is not in wave 1.

shellFacts.title: Document title is route-derived (Overview, Diagnostics id, Not found path) and asserted across navigation.
shellFacts.theme: THEME_STORAGE_KEY=role-model-runtime-theme; initial dark unless stored light/dark; toggle writes document dataset/class/color-scheme/meta and localStorage through ApplyTheme Command; test asserts dark -> light.
shellFacts.focus: No forced focus restoration, matching the legacy shell: the activated navigation link keeps document focus; active route is communicated by aria-current.
shellFacts.scroll: ChangedUrl dispatches ScrollShellToTop (window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'auto'})); test spies the call. The legacy content-container scroll becomes the page scroll because the Foldkit shell uses the document scroller.
shellFacts.navigation: Persistent primary navigation is one sidebar + one mobile nav; 9 legacy sections are explicit pending entries, not fabricated links.

inventory.driftExtension: Verified rows now require proofTest + proofTestName; the drift test asserts the proof file exists and contains it("<name>"). Wired app-shell names its test but is not claimed verified.
